name: Rannamaari
source:
This story is based upon the mythological story of Maldives, about a sea spirit called Rannamaari who terrorized the country of Maldives. It mains a Moroccan traveler called Abu Barakath Yusuf-ul Barbari, who came to Maldives to trade. However, he was pulled into the affairs of the country and you take control of Abu Barakath and try to save the day!
